name: DCA Clarabelle's Hand-Scooped Ice Cream Dairy-Free Mango Sorbet or Custom Ice Cream Bar (Lactase)
brandOrRestaurant: Clarabelle's Hand-Scooped Ice Cream (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Clarabelle's carries plant-based/dairy-free frozen options (and mango sorbet cups) with zero lactose, or you can use lactase enzymes to enjoy a hand-dipped Vanilla bar with milk chocolate coating (no nuts/popping candy).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Plant-Based Vanilla/Chocolate scoop or Mango Sorbet cup (verify no lemon juice if citrus-sensitive); if ordering a hand-dipped bar with lactase, choose plain chocolate dip with no nuts or whole raspberries.
watchOuts: Avoid mixed-berry toppings with raspberry/blackberry seeds and nut coatings
